answer.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Claim_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name
FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
JOIN party_role AS pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
JOIN policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
    ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim AS c
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN catastrophe AS cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) = 'agent';

SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    SUM(loss_amount) AS total_loss_amount
FROM (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount AS loss_amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_payment AS lp
      ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount AS loss_amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_reserve AS lr
      ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
) AS losses
JOIN claim AS c
  ON losses.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

answer.sql:
WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        c.Company_Claim_Number,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM claim AS c
    JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN policy AS p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
),
claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment AS lp
                WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve AS lr
                WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment AS ep
                WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve AS er
                WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premium_totals AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM premium AS pr
        WHERE pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(
                    COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Code, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, ''),
                    '(?i)policy[ _-]?holder|insured|policy[ _-]?owner'
                )
                THEN COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''),
                    o.Organization_Name,
                    CAST(pa.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
                )
            END,
            ', '
        ) AS policy_holder,
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(
                    COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Code, '') || ' ' ||
                    COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, ''),
                    '(?i)agent|producer'
                )
                THEN COALESCE(
                    NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''),
                    o.Organization_Name,
                    CAST(pa.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
                )
            END,
            ', '
        ) AS agent
    FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
    LEFT JOIN party_role AS pr
        ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN party AS pa
        ON pa.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN person AS pe
        ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations AS o
        ON o.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    pp.policy_holder,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(pt.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    pp.agent
FROM claim_policy AS cp
LEFT JOIN claim_totals AS ct
    ON ct.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_totals AS pt
    ON pt.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties AS pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY cp.Company_Claim_Number, cp.Policy_Number;

answer.sql:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_ID
FROM policy AS p
LEFT JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND LOWER(apr.Party_Role_Code) = 'agent';

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    AVG(date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)) AS Average_Days_To_Settle
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) AS cp
JOIN claim AS c
    ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy AS p
    ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date IS NOT NULL
  AND c.Claim_Close_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH loss_components AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.Claim_Amount), 0) AS total_loss
FROM claim AS c
LEFT JOIN claim_amount AS ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_components AS lc
    ON lc.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

SELECT
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM policy), 0) AS average_policy_size
FROM premium AS p
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
    ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.Policy_Number,
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS Claim_Number
FROM policy AS p
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN claim AS c
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, Claim_Number;

SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS policies_sold
FROM policy AS p
JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE LOWER(apr.Party_Role_Code) = 'agent'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY apr.Party_Identifier;

WITH claim_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS loss
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment AS lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve AS lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment AS ep WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve AS er WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_claim AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM policy AS p
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
        ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT
    pc.Policy_Number,
    AVG(cl.loss) AS average_loss
FROM policy_claim AS pc
JOIN claim_loss AS cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = pc.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY pc.Policy_Number
ORDER BY pc.Policy_Number;

answer.sql:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Policy_Holder_Identifier
FROM policy AS p
LEFT JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    AND (
        regexp_replace(lower(apr.Party_Role_Code), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = 'policyholder'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM party_role AS pr
            WHERE pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
              AND regexp_replace(lower(pr.Party_Role_Name), '[^a-z]', '', 'g') = 'policyholder'
        )
    );

WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve AS x WHERE x.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN policy AS p
      ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    cp.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    SUM(ct.total_loss) AS total_loss
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_totals AS ct
  ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN catastrophe AS cat
  ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_policies AS cp
  ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premiums
FROM premium AS p
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
  ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier;

WITH loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
),
claim_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number
    FROM claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN policy AS p
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cp.Policy_Number,
    SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss
FROM loss_amounts AS la
JOIN claim_amount AS ca
    ON la.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN claim AS c
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN catastrophe AS cat
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN claim_policies AS cp
    ON c.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums
FROM policy AS p
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium AS pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH agent_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id,
        p.Policy_Identifier AS policy_id
    FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
    JOIN policy AS p
      ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
    WHERE UPPER(apr.Party_Role_Code) = 'AGENT'
),
claim_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier AS claim_id,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier AS policy_id
    FROM claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier AS claim_id, ca.Claim_Amount AS amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_payment AS lp USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_reserve AS lr USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN expense_payment AS ep USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN expense_reserve AS er USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
)
SELECT
    ap.agent_id,
    ap.policy_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(la.amount), 0) AS total_loss
FROM agent_policies AS ap
LEFT JOIN claim_policies AS cp
  ON cp.policy_id = ap.policy_id
LEFT JOIN loss_amounts AS la
  ON la.claim_id = cp.claim_id
GROUP BY ap.agent_id, ap.policy_id
ORDER BY ap.agent_id, ap.policy_id;

answer.sql:
WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment lp
                WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS loss_payment_amount,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve lr
                WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS loss_reserve_amount,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment ep
                WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) FILTER (
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve er
                WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
        ) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM claim_amount ca
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM policy_amount pa
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM premium pr
        WHERE pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_parties AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT COALESCE(
                NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name), ''),
                o.Organization_Name,
                CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
            ),
            ', '
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%holder%'
        ) AS policy_holder,
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT COALESCE(
                NULLIF(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name), ''),
                o.Organization_Name,
                CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
            ),
            ', '
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(pr.Party_Role_Name, apr.Party_Role_Code)) LIKE '%agent%'
        ) AS agent
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    LEFT JOIN party_role pr ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN party pt ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    pp.policy_holder,
    COALESCE(pm.premium_amount_paid, 0) AS premium_amount_paid,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    pp.agent,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_payment_amount, 0) AS loss_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.loss_reserve_amount, 0) AS loss_reserve_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_payment_amount, 0) AS expense_payment_amount,
    COALESCE(ct.expense_reserve_amount, 0) AS expense_reserve_amount
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN claim_totals ct ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
) cp ON cp.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premiums pm ON pm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_parties pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY claim_number, policy_number;

SELECT
    apr.Party_Identifier AS policy_holder_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.Policy_Identifier) AS policy_count
FROM policy AS p
JOIN agreement_party_role AS apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN party_role AS pr
    ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(pr.Party_Role_Name, ' ', '')) = 'policyholder'
GROUP BY apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY policy_holder_id;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS Claim_Count
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
    ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

WITH claim_policy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Policy_Number,
        cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM policy AS p
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
      ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
      ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION ALL
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
),
claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_amounts AS la
      ON la.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Policy_Number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    AVG(COALESCE(cl.total_loss, 0)) AS average_loss
FROM claim_policy AS cp
LEFT JOIN claim_losses AS cl
  ON cl.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier, cp.Policy_Number
ORDER BY cp.Policy_Number;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premiums_Paid
FROM policy AS p
JOIN policy_amount AS pa
    ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN premium AS pr
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier

answer.sql:
WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_payment WHERE Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loss_reserve WHERE Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_payment WHERE Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expense_reserve WHERE Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount_paid
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS pr
      ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_holders AS (
    SELECT
        apr.Agreement_Identifier,
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT COALESCE(
                NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', pe.First_Name, pe.Middle_Name, pe.Last_Name)), ''),
                o.Organization_Name,
                CAST(pt.Party_Name AS VARCHAR)
            ),
            ', '
        ) AS policy_holder
    FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
    JOIN party_role AS pr
      ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    LEFT JOIN party AS pt
      ON pt.Party_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN person AS pe
      ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN organizations AS o
      ON o.Organization_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    WHERE LOWER(pr.Party_Role_Name) LIKE '%policy%holder%'
    GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    p.Policy_Number AS policy_number,
    ph.policy_holder,
    pm.premium_amount_paid,
    ct.total_loss
FROM claim AS c
JOIN claim_totals AS ct
  ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN claim_coverage AS cc
  ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN policy AS p
  ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premiums AS pm
  ON pm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_holders AS ph
  ON ph.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
ORDER BY claim_number, policy_number;

        SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (

        ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_payment_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (

            WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
        ) THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense_reserve_amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca

),
premium_totals AS (

    COUNT(cp.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(SUM(cl.total_loss), 0) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(SUM(cl.total_loss), 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(pt.premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM policy AS p

  ON pt.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier

  ON cp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
